name: Getscreen
summary: Browser-based remote desktop and remote-support software: connect to any computer with no client install, share one-click access links, transfer files and record sessions — for IT teams, MSPs and remote support.
best_for: IT and support people who want browser-based remote access without installing software on the other person's machine — at a fair price or a one-time fee
skip_if: you need the absolute lowest latency (AnyDesk) or heavy compliance certifications like HIPAA/SOC 2 (TeamViewer)
honest_knock: AnyDesk tends to feel faster and lower-latency, and TeamViewer carries the heavier security/compliance certifications (HIPAA, SOC 2). Getscreen's real edge is being fully browser-based — nothing to install on the other person's machine — and cheaper, especially with the lifetime deal.

pricing.plans_source: hand-curated from the vendor's pricing page
pricing.notes: (price re-verified 2026-09-23) Business rates on getscreen.me/en/pricing/plans/ are quoted on annual payment, which the page marks 16% off. The figures were first read over a US connection on 2026-08-26 as dollars and have not moved since; from a Dutch connection the same numerals print as euros, so the currency symbol follows the visitor region rather than the price. The business subscription bills on two meters at once, and quoting only the first understates it: Standard is $4.17 per technician a month plus $0.08 per device, Advanced $6.67 plus $0.13, and Enterprise $8.33 plus $0.17. Advanced and Enterprise add unlimited client invitations. Free plan (2 devices); paid tiers add one-time quick connections (Advanced) and white-label, roles and mass-device management (Enterprise) — plus a one-time Personal Lifetime Deal at $149 in the page as served, which a browser on a European connection re-renders as EUR 139 (a different number, not just a different symbol, unlike the business rates), and which sidesteps the recurring fees of rivals like TeamViewer (~$50/mo). Without annual payment the business rates are 5.00 / 8.00 / 10.00 per technician and 0.10 / 0.15 / 0.20 per device a month (Standard / Advanced / Enterprise). The HTTP API is absent on Standard and limited to 100 requests per hour per device on Advanced and 1,000 on Enterprise; video recording storage is 1 GB, 2 GB and 5 GB per technician.

free_plan_evidence: Free plan (2 devices); paid tiers add one-time quick connections (Advanced) and white-label, roles and mass-device management (Enterprise) — plus a one-time Personal Lifetime Deal at $149 in the page as served, which a browser on a European connection re-renders as EUR 139 (a different number, not just a different symbol, unlike the business rates), and which sidesteps the recurring fees of rivals like TeamViewer (~$50/mo).
